name: Drake Courser

generalAbilities.name: Snow Vision
generalAbilities.description: Snow doesn't impair a drake courser's vision; it ignores concealment from snowfall.

defensiveAbilities.name: Attack of Opportunity (Special)
defensiveAbilities.description:
Tail only. On a critical hit, the target is knocked Prone; if the target was using a move action, its movement ends.

Trigger A creature within the monster's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Effect The monster attempts a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, the monster disrupts that action. This Strike doesn't count toward the monster's multiple attack penalty, and its multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

speed:
35 ft,
climb 35 ft,
fly 65 ft,
swim 35 ft,

offensiveAbilities.name: Battle Dance
offensiveAbilities.description: The drake courser makes two fangs Strikes and one tail Strike in any order. It can replace any of these Strikes with Demoralize or Step.

offensiveAbilities.name: Buffeting Surge
offensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency three times per day

Effect The drake courser moves up to twice its Speed. It can attempt to Trip with its tail once at any point during its movement.

offensiveAbilities.name: Freezing Mist Breath
offensiveAbilities.description: The drake spits a ball of liquid up to 60 feet that explodes into a 20 foot burst of freezing mist. Those in the burst take 13d6 cold damage (DC 31 basic Reflex save). The mist cakes all surfaces in the area with a sheet of slippery ice that turns the area into difficult terrain for 2d4 rounds. It can't use Freezing Mist Breath again for 1d6 rounds.

offensiveAbilities.name: Ice Climb (35 feet)
offensiveAbilities.description: A drake courser can climb on ice as though it had the listed climb Speed. It ignores difficult terrain and greater difficult terrain from ice and snow and doesn't risk falling when crossing ice.
